subject: Process ownership — Shipping CS Monday board
body:
Hi all,

Who currently owns the Monday board for shipping CS? I need to update some access permissions and want to make sure I route the request to the right person.

If there's a process-ownership doc somewhere I missed, point me at it.

Thanks,
Arvin

expected_outcome.notes: Meta/governance question — classify_email Rule 2 catches it and routes to Escalate / Needs Human Review (not Shipping CS even though body mentions 'Shipping CS'). select_sop matches SOP-08 (Support Channel Conflict) and authorises drafting an internal reply that punts to CS Lead with uncommitted_items rather than dead-ending in pure escalate. CS Lead approves the draft before send.
